content: Pain is inevitable. Suffering is optional.
author: Haruki Murakami
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Hardship is not an unfair interruption to your real life—it is the very forge in which character is tempered. No one develops deep wisdom, empathy, or stamina by cruising down an easy path without resistance.

Haruki Murakami understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Like a tree that develops deeper roots when buffeted by winter gales, your past trials gave you a reservoir of strength you didn't know you possessed. You are more durable than your anxious thoughts give you credit for.
reflectionPrompt: What would happen if you met today's stress with steady acceptance rather than resistance?
